design.faqTitle: Everything you need to know before your adventure
design.faq1: Does sending an enquiry confirm my booking?
design.faq1Body: No. Our coordinator must confirm the final price and availability. Opening WhatsApp or preparing a message does not confirm a booking.
design.faq2: Which currency are prices displayed in?
design.faq2Body: All indicative prices are in US dollars (USD). Please confirm the final price of your plan with our coordinator.
design.faq3: Can I request a plan for a group?
design.faq3Body: Yes. Enter the number of adults and children, and add your preferences in the enquiry notes.
design.faq4: What happens to my personal information?
design.faq4Body: The form keeps your information in memory only. You decide when to copy your message or continue in WhatsApp.
